everyone_armed.gml: var kinds = ["bandits", "robots", "corps", "insects"]; for (var n = 0; n < 80; n++) { var d = 0.85 + (n mod 12) * 0.1; var g = enemy_group(kinds[n mod 4], d, false, false); var guns = 0; for (var c = 0; c < array_length(g); c++) { var car = g[c]; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(car.facs); i++) if (fac(car.facs[i].def).charge > 0 && fac_active(car.facs[i])) guns += 1; } if (guns == 0) return false; } return true;
